title: 20th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/2/2025).
Approval of the minutes of five previous sittings (minutes Nos. 15/2/2025 to 19/2/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of four members to the board of the Maldives Inland Revenue Authority under Article 4(b)(2) of the Tax Administration Act (Law No. 3/2010) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for Chief Justice under Article 147 of the Constitution is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah South MP Ibrahim Hussain.
First reading of the Bill amending the National Payment System Act (Law No. 8/2021), submitted on behalf of the government by Makunudhoo MP Adam Shafeeq.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Penal Code (Law No. 9/2014), submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah South MP Ibrahim Hussain.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill amending the Water and Sewerage Act (Law No. 8/2020), submitted on behalf of the government by Dhidhdhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Hulhumale South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed seeking members' views on the high cost of electricity and water for small and medium businesses operating outside Male.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, sent MIRA board and Chief Justice nominees to committee, introduced and debated Decentralisation, Payment System and Penal Code amendment bills, and continued two unfinished debates.
